events_chronological: Border-city police officers Nuno and Tavo intercept a drug shipment in the desert and have it taken off them by the army commander Obrero's men.
Obrero recruits Nuno onto his anti-cartel task force, which is in fact a front for the northern cartel.
Nuno helps capture the coastal cartel's enforcer Paz, who is tortured into naming the hit man Blanco.
Across the border, federal drug agents Brand and Dell arrest the mid-level dealer Nando Cano and turn him into a witness.
Cano's testimony brings the arrest of the importer Rafael Solis in front of his pregnant wife Nadia, who knows nothing about the business.
Judge Warren Bell is appointed the country's drug policy director and briefed in the capital on a war nobody there thinks can be won.
Bell's sixteen-year-old daughter Simone and her friends free-base at a party, and one of them nearly dies of it.
Nadia discovers that the family is bankrupt and that the cartel is threatening her son over her husband's debts.
Nadia goes to Rafael's lawyer Metz and then arranges a meeting with the coastal cartel's brothers herself.
Simone's habit moves from cocaine to heroin, and she is arrested and thrown out of school.
Nadia commissions Blanco to kill Cano before he can testify.
Bell tours the border, meets Obrero, and is told by everyone he talks to that treatment is the only thing that works.
Simone runs away and starts prostituting herself for drugs in an inner-city motel.
Blanco's car bomb kills Dell instead of Cano.
Bell abandons his official duties and searches the motels of his own state for his daughter himself.
Tavo tries to sell what he knows about Obrero to the agents and is executed in the desert in front of Nuno.
Blanco poisons Cano in protective custody, and the case against Rafael Solis collapses.
Nuno gives Obrero up to the agents, and the commander is exposed as the northern cartel's man and arrested.
Bell resigns at his own press conference, saying he cannot fight a war against his own family.
Brand plants a bug at the party celebrating Rafael's release, Nadia takes over running the business, and Nuno watches the floodlit baseball game he asked for as his price.
nonlinear_category_reason: Three concurrent strands in three cities, told apart by colour; the reordering is lateral between simultaneous events rather than backwards in time.
syuzhet_notes: Three strands - the border city, the capital and the inland state, the coastal city - are intercut from the first reel and told apart by colour rather than captions, one bleached yellow and one filtered cold blue. The strands run concurrently, so most of the reordering is lateral, the film moving between cities at roughly the same date; the exceptions are told-order bullets 6, 7 and 11, which drop back behind their neighbours to fill in what a character already knew.
fabula_notes: The three strands never fully converge and share almost no scenes, so the ordering across them is inferred from a handful of common markers - the dealer's arrest, his testimony, his death. The importer's business dealings before his arrest are established through testimony and never dramatised.

events.content: The officers' apparent success in the desert lasts only until uniformed soldiers arrive and take both prisoners and contraband.

Nuno: Obrero can overrule local police in the desert
reader: the army controls the intercepted shipment

events.content: The commander rewards the officer with a place on an elite task force, concealing that its raids protect one cartel from another.

reader: the task force secretly serves the northern cartel

questions.q1: will Nuno discover whom Obrero's task force really serves?

events.content: A coastal enforcer is isolated, tortured and forced to identify the killer who handles the cartel's most sensitive work.

Nuno: Blanco is the coastal cartel's contract killer
reader: the task force uses torture and is targeting the coastal organisation

events.content: Across the border, two agents offer a mid-level dealer survival in exchange for testimony against the importer above him.

Nando Cano: testimony may keep him out of prison
reader: Cano can connect the agents to Rafael Solis

questions.q2: can Cano survive long enough to testify?

events.content: Cano's information reaches into a wealthy home, where the importer's surprised wife sees the legitimate surface of her life collapse.

Nadia: her husband is accused of importing drugs
reader: Cano's testimony is the foundation of the case

events.content: Capital briefings give the new director large maps and larger promises, while experienced officials quietly tell him the campaign has no measurable end.

Judge Warren Bell: officials do not believe interdiction can end drug use
reader: Bell has public authority over a war already regarded as unwinnable

events.content: The director's daughter uses a potent form of cocaine in an affluent bedroom and watches a friend stop responding.

Simone: her social drug use can become immediately dangerous
reader: Bell's policy problem exists inside his own household

questions.q3: how will Bell respond when the drug crisis reaches his own family?

events.content: Frozen accounts and a threat against her son make clear that innocence will not preserve the family she thought she had.

Nadia: the family is bankrupt and her son is collateral for Rafael's debt
reader: Nadia has a coercive reason to enter the trade

questions.q4: what will Nadia become in order to protect her family?

events.content: After the family lawyer offers no rescue, she crosses the line her husband kept hidden and bargains directly with his suppliers.
events.location: a lawyer's office and a cartel meeting place

Nadia: Cano must be silenced for Rafael to be released
reader: Nadia has chosen the business as the means of saving her family

events.content: Arrest and expulsion do not interrupt her habit; they remove the remaining routines that had hidden its speed from her parents.

reader: punishment has accelerated Simone's isolation

events.content: Using the name and channels of the organisation, she commissions the death of the witness on whom the federal case depends.

Blanco: Nadia wants Cano dead before he testifies
reader: the border investigation and the importer's case now share one killer

events.content: Officials display seizures and commanders, but the people closest to addiction repeatedly tell Bell that treatment accomplishes what enforcement cannot.

Judge Warren Bell: front-line workers regard treatment as the only durable intervention
reader: Bell meets the corrupt commander without recognising him

questions.q5: will Bell keep directing a policy he no longer believes in?

events.content: Heroin strips away school, friends and home until she exchanges sex for the next dose in a room her father does not know how to search for.

reader: Simone's addiction has reached immediate personal danger

events.content: The device intended for the cooperating witness detonates beside an agent instead, leaving Cano alive and making the cost of the case personal for Brand.

Brand: the cartel can reach the witness and has killed his partner
reader: the first attempt on Cano failed

events.content: The national director abandons prepared speeches to work through motel corridors as a frightened father with no institutional shortcut.

Judge Warren Bell: his office cannot solve the intimate crisis in his family
reader: Bell chooses Simone over his official schedule

events.content: Tavo's effort to sell proof of the commander's allegiance ends in the desert, where Nuno is made to watch the price of dissent.

Nuno: Obrero serves the northern cartel and will kill his own officers
reader: the task force's corruption is now undeniable to Nuno

events.content: A second, quieter attack succeeds inside protection; without its cooperating witness, the prosecution loses the testimony holding Rafael.

Brand: the case against Rafael cannot survive Cano's death
reader: Nadia's bargain has achieved its immediate aim

events.content: Rather than accept Tavo's death as a warning, Nuno gives federal agents the commander's link to the northern cartel and watches the task force lose its protector.

the federal agents: Obrero's anti-cartel unit protects the northern cartel
reader: Nuno converts Tavo's failed disclosure into evidence

events.content: At the press conference meant to announce strategy, Bell rejects the metaphor of war because it would make his daughter an enemy.

reader: Bell has accepted the contradiction between punishment policy and care for his family

events.content: Brand bugs the celebration of Rafael's release, Nadia assumes the business role she entered to save him, and Nuno receives a lit playing field instead of money.
events.location: a release party and a border-city playing field

Brand: surveillance of Rafael's network can continue
reader: none of the victories ends the trade, though individual choices change lives
